matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the same defect: withdrawEth requires the balance to cover amountWei + feeWei, even though the fee is deducted from amountWei.
Finding 4 identifies the same defect: deleteWithdrawMessage clears startTime but leaves withdrawMsgIdProcessed set, so the cancelled id cannot be reused.
Finding 3 identifies the same defect: validWithdrawMessage accepts a zero feeReceiver, which is inconsistent with how Treasury.withdrawEth handles the fee receiver.
No finding covers claimWithdrawal updating state after the external call. Finding 6 is about reentrancy in emergencyWithdraw, which is a different function.
No finding mentions unused variables or constants.
Finding 2 identifies the same defect: _authorizeWithdraw does not check withdrawMsgIdProcessed, so the same withdrawId can be reused in a different message.
